supersedes: covid_transport_fit_01_* — same scenario, base_overrides and observation structure verbatim; the arm axis is now Theta over a declared candidate grid instead of the transport solver.
description: Post-airflow-repair Theta refit: the COVID arm's one fitted composite (emission scale x per-copy risk) re-selected on the boxed_s1s2 Diamond Princess replay under the shipped post-B1-B3 mass budget (near-field two_box, pool airflow, room-air first_order ambient_on, duty-0 extract, open_deck ambient sinks), then scored held-out on Greg Mortimer. Identical cell shape to TRANSPORT-FIT-01: single 'baseline' arm with empty overrides resolves the shipped native engine; Theta is the only axis. Objective at merge: covid.T1 (recorded onsets 197 + onsets_on_or_after_day) + covid.T3 (712 positives), log-residual, equal weights — the ThetaObjective in picard_framework/covid_theta_fit.py.
base_overrides_note: The boxed_s1s2 resolved configuration of CREW-REACH-01 — the boxed crew-mess SOP (SOP-017-MESSBOX) plus section-bound steward service (direction both, service_responder_mode section, cabins [10,15], contact_factor_to_host [0.005,0.02]) plus the record's full observation structure (serial retest tiers and the day-34 crew wave) — applied once to every cell, identical across arms. Composition is order-independent against the single arm axis, which writes only config_overrides.hvac.transport_engine.

arms.note: Single arm so empty overrides per the arm grammar — the whole shipped post-repair stack runs: near_field two_box (204 m3/h, ratio 0.43), pathogen_pool_transport airflow, room_air_removal first_order ambient_on, duty0_terminal_mode extract, ambient openings + envelope/exhaust sinks. Resolved engine auditable via delivery.transport_engine_resolved == ContamTransportEngine.

cells_note: 1 arm x 12 Theta candidates x 20 seeds = 240 cells. Same seed series as TF-01/RI-01 so every cell pairs seed-for-seed with the repair-isolation baseline arm. Theta grid: the currently fitted 7.9e6 plus the v5/v6 first-look half-decade surface 1e7..1e12; a winner at either end is boundary-pinned by convention.
